_comment: Skill-level policy for ATS skill matrices. Arion's rule (2026-09-29): a resume parser defaults everything to Novice, which reads worse than saying nothing - Github at Novice is actively misleading. Popular tools and frameworks that appear in the CV or in his GitHub projects are Advanced; everything else the parser extracted is Intermediate. Never Novice.
_drop_comment: Parser noise. Claiming these is worse than omitting them - they are not in the CV at all.
_advanced_rule: Only terms Arion can point to in the CV or a GitHub project. Anything else takes the Intermediate floor - over-claiming is worse than the floor, because he has to defend it.
